objective: Aplicar exclusivamente en EDARSAHUB Desarrollo la migracion 004 del modulo Sincronizacion Historica para extender la bitacora canonica Sync_Logs con SyncControlID, CorrelationID, EventCode y PayloadJSON, manteniendo FK, JSON check e indice. No tocar Produccion ni sync_comercial_abiertas_v2.

queries.name: sync_historical_logs_preflight
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Logs','U') AS logs_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','U') AS ledger_id, 1/CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Logs','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','U') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preflight_assertion

queries.name: sync_historical_logs_post_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS required_columns, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS columns_assertion FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Logs') AND name IN ('SyncControlID','CorrelationID','EventCode','PayloadJSON')

queries.name: sync_historical_logs_post_contract
queries.sql: SELECT 1/CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE name='FK_Sync_Logs_SyncControl') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name='CK_Sync_Logs_PayloadJSON') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Logs') AND name='IX_Sync_Logs_Control_Time') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS logs_contract_assertion
